Frequent fluid checks and an auxiliary cooler help; avoid heavy towing.

rows.title: Forward Emergency Braking (FEB) Phantom / False Activation
rows.howToFix: Keep the front camera window (behind the windshield) and front radar/emblem area clean and free of film, mud, snow or aftermarket tint. Have the dealer scan the ADAS modules and apply any camera/radar calibration or software update per TSB. If phantom braking persists, request a diagnosis of the radar/camera alignment; the FEB sensitivity setting can be reviewed but the system should not be defeated permanently.

rows.title: Infotainment System Freezing
rows.howToFix: Update to the latest infotainment firmware. Perform a factory reset if issues persist. Delete and re-pair all Bluetooth devices. Infiniti has released multiple software updates addressing stability.

rows.title: Premature 12V Battery Failure / Parasitic Drain (No-Start, Warning Cascade)
rows.howToFix: Load-test the battery and charging system; replace with a correct OEM-spec Group 35/AGM battery if degraded. If the battery drains while parked, perform a parasitic-draw test to isolate a module (infotainment/telematics) staying awake. Reprogram/replace the battery and register it if the system requires. Address any charging (alternator) fault and keep the battery topped up on a maintainer during long storage.

rows.title: VC-Turbo Engine Main/Link Bearing Failure (Safety Recall)
rows.howToFix: Have the VIN checked for the recall. The remedy reprograms the ECM, scans for diagnostic codes, and inspects the oil pan for metal debris; if metal is found the engine is replaced free of charge. Owners should keep to strict oil-change intervals, use the correct 0W-20 spec oil, and stop driving immediately if knocking, ticking or metal in the oil is noticed. Because a warranty extension applies, keep all service records to protect coverage.

rows.title: CVT Transmission Failure
rows.howToFix: Replace CVT fluid every 30,000 miles instead of the recommended 60,000. Add an auxiliary transmission cooler for towing. Nissan extended the CVT warranty to 84 months/84,000 miles on affected models.

rows.title: Power Steering Pump Whine
rows.howToFix: Flush the power steering system and refill with Nissan PSF. Bleed air from the system by turning the wheel lock-to-lock several times with the engine running. Replace the pump if the noise persists after fluid service.

rows.title: Transmission Judder at Low Speed
rows.howToFix: Have the dealer perform the CVT judder reprogram (TSB NTB15-024). A CVT fluid change with NS-3 fluid can also improve the condition. Drive the vehicle for 30 minutes after the fluid change to allow the TCM to relearn.

rows.title: Battery Drain / No-Start from Telematics, Infotainment, or Control Module Sleep Issues
rows.howToFix: Perform a proper parasitic draw test after all modules should be asleep, then isolate the circuit causing excess current draw. Check for TSB/software updates for telematics/AV modules, test battery health, and inspect charging system output; some vehicles need module reprogramming, while others require battery replacement after repeated deep discharge damage. Document draw readings before replacing parts.

rows.title: Panoramic Moonroof Exploding or Cracking Spontaneously

Avoid driving with exposed broken glass until the panel is secured or replaced.
